global.footer_blurb: Premium ground handling, luxury transfers and tailored tours across Victoria Falls, Hwange, Kasane and Livingstone.

transfers.intro_text:
Choose from our private or scheduled transfer options for convenient and flexible travel. Our drivers are not only highly experienced but also qualified professional tour guides, ready to share their knowledge along the way.

We uphold the highest standards of safety and comfort through routine maintenance and rigorous vehicle checks, ensuring every journey is smooth, secure and stress-free.
transfers.r5_text: Effortlessly travel from Kasane Airport to your destination, with timely pickups and drop-offs into Botswana.
transfers.r4_text: Experience smooth transfers from Livingstone Airport to your chosen location. Prompt, courteous drivers ensure you reach your destination safely.
transfers.r3_text: Travel comfortably to Hwange Main Camp with our dedicated transfer service — a safe, pleasant journey through the stunning landscapes of Hwange National Park.
transfers.r2_text: Enjoy hassle-free transfers within Victoria Falls town, whether you're heading to attractions, dining spots or shopping areas — promptly and comfortably.
transfers.r1_text: Seamlessly connect from Victoria Falls Airport to your destination. Our professional drivers greet you on arrival, assist with your luggage, and ensure a stress-free journey to your accommodation.
transfers.hero_text: From the comfort of our air-conditioned vehicles to the exceptional quality of service, every Signature Africa transfer is an elevated travel experience.

fleet.v6_text: Our 28-seater King Long Coach is designed for larger groups seeking luxury and comfort — a premium travel experience for tours, corporate events and group excursions.
fleet.v5_text: The Hino Coaster is our premier solution for larger-scale transport, accommodating up to 20 passengers with ease. This meticulously maintained vehicle ensures your entire party travels in total comfort and safety.
fleet.v4_text: Ideal for larger groups, the Toyota Hiace offers comfortable seating for up to 13 passengers — everyone travels together in comfort and safety.
fleet.v3_text: Our Toyota Quantums are spacious transfer vehicles seating 6 to 13, perfect for small to medium-sized groups, with ample legroom and advanced safety features for a comfortable, enjoyable journey.
fleet.v2_text: The Toyota Majesty is a high-end executive MPV that trades passenger capacity for first-class luxury — a limousine-like experience with premium quilted leather, motorised ottomans and advanced safety tech, making it the ideal choice for VIP transport and elite corporate travel.
fleet.v1_text: Experience ultimate luxury with our Ineos Grenadier, a 4-seater Signature Class vehicle available for daily hire. Ideal for discerning travellers, it offers unmatched comfort, advanced features and a smooth ride for exclusive journeys.
fleet.hero_text: A vehicle for every party size, every terrain and every occasion — each one maintained to the highest standards of safety and comfort.

victoria_falls.g3_text: The Batoka Gorge is one of the world's great adventure playgrounds — Grade 5 rapids, a 111m gorge swing, and Africa's highest bungee jump.
victoria_falls.e1_text: A traditional African feast with live drumming, dancers and a fire-lit boma setting — an unforgettable Victoria Falls evening.
victoria_falls.intro_text: Signature Africa's Victoria Falls operation covers every touchpoint of your visit — private transfers, airside VIP handling, and a full calendar of guided tours, adrenaline activities and river cruises.
victoria_falls.g2_text: See the Falls, the gorges and the wildlife below from a Bell helicopter — the only way to take in the full scale of Mosi-a-Tunya.
victoria_falls.g1_text: Private, professional transport from the moment you land to the moment you check in.

victoria_falls.g3_i1_text: 111 metres of freefall from the historic Victoria Falls Bridge, suspended between Zimbabwe and Zambia.
victoria_falls.g5_i2_text: An evening cruise with a full dinner service and cocktail bar on board.

victoria_falls.hero_text: From VIP airport meet & greet to adrenaline on the Zambezi, every way to experience the Smoke That Thunders.

tours.adventures_text: White Water Rafting · Bungee Jumping · Bridge Slide · Bridge Swing · Gorge Swing · Zipline · Flying Fox · Canopy Tour
tours.t5_text: Delve into the vibrant township areas near Victoria Falls, discovering the resilience and community spirit that define township living.
tours.t4_text: A captivating journey through a vibrant rural village near Victoria Falls, led by a warm community member — an authentic look into Zimbabwean village life, traditions and customs.
tours.t3_text: Elevate your adventure with breath-taking helicopter tours. Choose a 12-minute scenic flight over the Falls, or a 25-minute flight over the wildlife of Zambezi National Park.
tours.t1_name: Guided Tour Of The Victoria Falls
tours.t2_text: A boat ride to Livingstone Island, insights into its history, the thrill of Devil's Pool or Angel's Pool, followed by a luxurious 5-star meal above the Falls.
tours.t1_text: Embark on a guided walking tour of Victoria Falls — a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World. Discover the rich history, geological marvels and vibrant ecosystems surrounding Mosi-a-Tunya, ‘The Smoke That Thunders.’
tours.hero_text: From guided walks along the Smoke That Thunders to helicopter flights, thrilling adventures and authentic community visits.

kasane.g3_text: A complete day combining game drive, river cruise and lunch, or a scenic day trip across the border to Victoria Falls.

kasane.g2_text: A morning or sunset boat safari along the Chobe River, famous for its dense elephant and hippo populations.

home.intro_text:
Every journey with Signature Africa is crafted to be more than just a transfer. It's defined by comfort, reliability and personal attention, delivered through a fleet of luxury vehicles, expert driver-guides and bespoke tour options.

Our knowledgeable guides are not just drivers, but storytellers who bring each destination to life — where excellence is the standard and every guest experience is a true ‘WOW’ moment.
home.feature2_text: Private Pilatus PC-12 charter flights throughout Zimbabwe and across the Southern African region, plus curated day trips to Hwange, Matopos and Great Zimbabwe.
home.feature1_text: A UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World. Accompanied by a knowledgeable guide, discover the rich history and vibrant ecosystems surrounding Mosi-a-Tunya, ‘The Smoke That Thunders.’
home.hero_text: Premium ground handling for leisure and corporate travellers exploring Victoria Falls, Hwange, Kasane and Livingstone. Seamless cross-border transfers and bespoke tours, delivered with comfort, reliability and personal attention.
